title: 第5章 墨云斋第6章 鉴宝
content_zh:
“噗嗤。”
祝星洲听罢笑出了声来。
“还说不是小孩子，这样的语气不是小孩子还能是什么？”
小白月一听，就气鼓鼓的。
云风虽也觉得白月有些孩子气，但觉得这也不失可爱，不过这个时候也不好去触她眉头，只好连哄带骗的把她带离了那个小摊。
“你觉得那画是真的？”
远离小摊后，云风凑到白月耳边轻轻的问。
“不，不真。”白月平静的回答。
“不真你还要花五十万去买它？”
云风此时真想撬开这小妮子的脑子，看看里面的构造是不是出了什么问题。
白月神秘一笑。
“我舍得花五十万，买的不是古玩，而是技术和人才。”
“你是觉得这画虽然不是真品，但这画工却栩栩如生，惟妙惟肖，你想找到这个作画人？”
云风一想便知道了这小妮子的意图。
“聪明！”
白月咯咯一笑，故作老成的拍了拍云风，一副孺子可教的模样。
“那你找个作画的肯定不是为了自己欣赏，你没有那么高的艺术鉴赏素养，你肯定是想卖钱。”
想通了其中缘由，云风一脸果然如此的表情。
“我说你这人怎么把我想得那么肤浅呢？我好歹也是个饱读诗书，博学多才的小朋友，怎么我就只认钱了？我就不会有点艺术细胞吗？云风同志，你这是先入为主的刻板印象，需要改正!”
白月抗议般的看着云风，一脸的义愤填膺。

“噗嗤，好好好。”
云风被白月的厚脸皮功夫给打倒了，在一旁隐隐偷笑着，随即便转移话题道。
“你看，前面就是墨云斋了。”
只见古玩街的末尾处，有一家白墙黛瓦的店铺，梁架上只有少量的雕刻，色彩素雅明净，显得古色古香，颇有韵味。
这古玩街上店铺的门面大多都是装修得雕梁画栋，好不霸气，唯独这间店铺的装修似有江南水乡的温婉，低调而内敛。
门上一副牌匾题字墨云斋，看这字体俊逸挺秀，倒也有一番别致的韵味。
一进到大堂，便有专人上来领路。
“你们好，两位是想来淘物件呢，还是鉴宝呢？”
“我们是来鉴宝的。”
content_en:
"Pfft."
Zhu Xingzhou laughed out loud after hearing this.
"You said you're not a child. What else can you say if you're not a child?"
When Xiao Baiyue heard this, she became very angry.
Although Yunfeng also felt that Bai Yue was a bit childish, he thought it was cute, but it was not easy to touch her brow at this time, so he had to coax and coax her away from the stall.
"Do you think that painting is real?"
After staying away from the stall, Yunfeng leaned into Bai Yue's ear and asked softly.
"No, not true." Bai Yue replied calmly.
"If it's not true, you still want to spend half a million to buy it?"
At this moment, Yunfeng really wanted to pry open this little girl's brain and see if there was anything wrong with the structure inside.
Bai Yue smiled mysteriously.
"I am willing to spend half a million to buy not antiques, but technology and talents."
"You think that although this painting is not authentic, the artist is lifelike and lifelike. Do you want to find the artist?"
Yunfeng knew the little girl's intention as soon as he thought about it.
"Smart!"
Bai Yue chuckled and patted Yunfeng in a mature manner, looking like a teachable child.
"Then you definitely didn't find a painter for your own appreciation. You don't have such a high level of art appreciation. You definitely want to sell it for money."
After figuring out the reason, Yunfeng looked like this.
"I asked you, why do you think of me so superficially? After all, I am a well-read poetry and erudite kid. Why do I only care about money? Don't I have some artistic talent? Comrade Yunfeng, this is a preconceived stereotype of yours and needs to be corrected!"
Bai Yue looked at Yunfeng in protest, with a face full of indignation.
"Pfft, okay, okay."
Yunfeng was knocked down by Bai Yue's shameless skills. He chuckled faintly and then changed the subject.
"Look, Mo Yunzhai is ahead."
At the end of the antique street, there is a shop with white walls and black tiles. There are only a few carvings on the beams. The colors are simple and elegant, making it look antique and charming.
Most of the storefronts on this antique street are decorated with intricate decorations, which are very domineering. However, the decoration of this store seems to have the gentleness of Jiangnan Water Town, low-key and restrained.
There is a plaque on the door with the inscription Mo Yunzhai. The font is elegant and elegant, but it also has a unique charm.
As soon as you enter the lobby, someone will come up to guide you.
"Hello, do you two want to come here to hunt for items or appraise treasures?"
"We are here to appraise the treasure."
